runSpans.description: The runs that matter on this branch's own part of its line: runs started on its own events, plus runs started on an ancestor that were still open at this branch's branch point (their `startedTick` lies on the parent's part of the line). This lets a branch only be started from a settled moment.

endedTick.description: Absent while the run is still open on this branch's line. Otherwise the first tick on this branch's line that closes the run (its finish, or a kernel restart). It is not before `startedTick`.
